mapper.update: MERGE INTO MEMBER_PROFILE T USING DUAL ON (T.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET INTRO = #{intro}, HEIGHT = #{height}, MBTI = #{mbti}, REGION_ID = #{regionId}, SCH_NO = #{schNo} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_NO, INTRO, HEIGHT, MBTI, REGION_ID, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, SCH_NO) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{intro}, #{height}, #{mbti}, #{regionId}, SYSDATE, 'M', #{schNo})

UPDATE "MEMBER" SET NICKNAME = #{nickname}, REL_INTENT_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{relationship}), AFFECT_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{affection}), EDU_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{education}), COMM_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{contact}), ZODIAC_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{zodiac}), EXERCISE_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{exercise}), DRINK_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{drinking}), SMOKE_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{smoking}), SNS_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{social}) WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}

SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME, NVL(TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, P.BIRTH_DATE) / 12), 0) AS AGE, M.SEARCH_DISTANCE, M.TARGET_MIN_AGE AS targetMinAge, M.TARGET_MAX_AGE AS targetMaxAge, M.TARGET_GENDER AS targetGender, M.PROFILE_OPEN AS profileOpen, S.SCH_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME, P.SCH_NO, P.INTRO, P.MBTI, P.GENDER, TO_CHAR(P.HEIGHT) AS HEIGHT, R.FULL_ADDR AS REGION_NAME, P.REGION_ID, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_ID = M.REL_INTENT_ID) AS RELATIONSHIP, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_ID = M.AFFECT_ID) AS AFFECTION, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_ID = M.EDU_ID) AS EDUCATION, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_ID = M.COMM_ID) AS CONTACT, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_ID = M.ZODIAC_ID) AS ZODIAC, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_ID = M.EXERCISE_ID) AS EXERCISE, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_ID = M.DRINK_ID) AS DRINKING, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_ID = M.SMOKE_ID) AS SMOKING, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_ID = M.SNS_ID) AS SOCIAL
FROM "MEMBER" M LEFT JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE P ON M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN SCHOOL S ON P.SCH_NO = S.SCH_NO LEFT JOIN MASTER_REGIONS R ON P.REGION_ID = R.REGION_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM MEMBER_INTERESTS I JOIN MASTER_CODES C ON I.INTEREST_ID = C.CODE_ID WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
